title: docs: improve deployment guide with common troubleshooting
body:
## Summary
- Warn to configure `preview.env` before running `bootstrap-cluster.sh` to avoid secrets being created with placeholder values
- Document that GitHub Apps created under a personal account must be made public before installing on an organization
- Add troubleshooting note for `PipelineRunPending` state caused by missing Kueue `LocalQueue`
- Add full guide for webhook forwarding on non-public clusters using smee.io and gosmee, including repo-level webhook and secret configuration
- Fix broken Pipelines as Code documentation link (old URL returns 404)

## Test plan
- [ ] Verify the deployment guide renders correctly on the docs site
- [ ] Follow the updated instructions on a fresh cluster to confirm accuracy
